title: LakshyaGraph
description: Full Lakshya graph document. A single JSON file stored in the app data directory holding every node, every edge, every manual priority pin, every dashboard filter preset, and global settings.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this document. Bumped on breaking changes so the repository layer can run migrations.

priority.description: User-assigned priority score. Higher ranks earlier in the default ordering.

positiveImpact.description: User-assigned positive impact estimate. Combined with priority for the default ordering.

deadline.description: Hard deadline for this node. Drives deadline reminders.

NodeStatus.description: Composite of two orthogonal axes: when the node is live (activation) and what it means to be done (completion). Either axis can be set independently, allowing e.g. 'active only during May, must be done 3 times in that window'.

Completion.description: Discriminated union of completion semantics. Absent (null) means this is a background goal with no completion concept.

Attachment.description: Discriminated union of attachment kinds linked to a node.

AttachmentTimeTrigger.description: Fires a reminder at the given moment, independent of any deadline on the node.

NodeNotificationSettings.description: Per-node override of the global notification defaults. Unset fields fall back to global Settings.

Edge.description: Directed contribution from a child node to a parent goal. A node can have many parents; the same child appears in multiple edges.

childId.description: The lower-level node that contributes upward.

parentId.description: The higher-level goal being contributed to.

contribution.description: Mandatory: parent is not fulfillable without this child. Helpful: child assists but is not required.

PriorityPin.description: Hard manual override declaring one node ranks above another, regardless of priority/impact scores.

FilterPreset.description: Dashboard tile. Tapping the tile opens a list or graph view pre-filtered by this filter.

iconName.description: Optional Material icon name for the tile face.

ordering.description: Sort order of tiles in the dashboard.

Filter.description: Composable filter spec used by the graph view, the todo list view, and dashboard tiles.

ancestorGoalIds.description: Keep only nodes that are descendants of at least one of these goals.

contribution.description: Restrict to incoming edges of this contribution kind when computing descendants.

completionKinds.description: Keep only nodes whose completion kind matches. 'none' matches background goals (no completion aspect).

activationKinds.description: Keep only nodes whose activation window kind matches.

onlyOngoing.description: Keep only currently-actionable nodes: one_time not completed, n_times with completedCount < targetCount, periodic past its next due date, temporarily_active inside its window and not completed.

onlyLeaves.description: Keep only nodes that are leaves within the filtered subgraph.

freeText.description: Case-insensitive substring match against node title and description.

defaultDeadlineLeadTimeHours.description: Default hours before a deadline at which a reminder fires. Nodes may override via notificationOverride.

notifyOnPeriodicReopenByDefault.description: Whether a notification fires when a periodic task becomes open again, unless the node overrides it.

rootNodeId.description: ID of the 'all goals achieved' top-level node. The graph engine treats this as the universal ancestor when computing descendant filters with no ancestorGoalIds set.
